units.source_text: 另外，祖父同那位叫丰川的富翁结识，是从寺庙的事开始的。

en.t: Also, my grandfather came to know the wealthy man named Toyokawa through matters concerning the temple.
There was a convent in our village.

units.source_text: 多半是昔日由我先祖兴建的。

en.t: It had most likely been built long ago by my ancestors.

units.source_text: 庙宇的建筑物和山林田地，都是在我家的名分之下的。

en.t: The temple buildings, the mountain woods, and the fields were all held under my family's name.

units.source_text: 尼姑也入了我们家的户籍。

en.t: The nun, too, was entered in our family register.

units.source_text: 属黄檗宗，正尊供奉虚空藏菩萨。

en.t: It belonged to the Obaku sect, and its principal image was Kokuzo Bosatsu.

units.source_text: 每年十三参拜节，邻近村庄十三岁的孩子都云集在这里，热闹异常。

en.t: Every year at the Thirteen Pilgrimage festival, thirteen-year-old children from the nearby villages gathered there, and it became extraordinarily lively.

units.source_text: 后来有一位深居在距我村北边一里地的著名山庙的圣僧，迁到这个寺庙来了。

en.t: Later, a holy monk who had secluded himself in a famous mountain temple about one ri north of our village moved to this temple.

units.source_text: 祖父非常敬重他，把尼姑打发走，还将这庙宇附属的财产卖掉。

en.t: My grandfather revered him deeply, sent the nun away, and even sold off the property attached to the temple.

units.source_text: 寺庙改建与增建，很是富丽堂皇，名称也更改了。

en.t: The temple was rebuilt and expanded until it became quite splendid, and its name was changed as well.

units.source_text: 修建寺庙期间，将虚空藏菩萨和其他五六尊佛像暂存在我家的客厅里。

en.t: While the temple was under construction, Kokuzo Bosatsu and five or six other Buddhist images were temporarily kept in our guest room.

units.source_text: 我家没钱换新的榻榻米，托佛爷的福，人家为了应急，在原先的藤席上又铺了新席，发出一股绿草的新席味……

en.t: Our family had no money to replace the tatami, but thanks to the Buddha, as an emergency measure people laid new mats over the old rattan ones, giving off the fresh green smell of new rush matting...

units.source_text: 这位叫丰川的财主信仰新迁来的圣僧，兴建寺庙，还为我家客厅铺设了新榻榻米。

en.t: This rich man named Toyokawa believed in the newly arrived holy monk, built the temple, and also had new tatami laid in our guest room.
